intervals.note: 2021-05 is the date of the earliest fetched source that describes LHAASO as already operating; it is a lower bound, not a sourced construction-start or full-completion date. Public reporting elsewhere describes a phased buildout with full-array completion later in 2021, but no source fetched this session states that date.

summary.plain: A high-altitude observatory on Haizi Mountain in Sichuan, China, that catches cosmic rays and the highest-energy gamma rays yet seen, using several kinds of ground detectors at once.
summary.technical: Multi-component high-altitude air-shower facility on Haizi Mountain, Daocheng County, Sichuan, China, at 4410 m altitude; operated by IHEP/Chinese Academy of Sciences.

notes: site_ids, accelerator_ids, beamline_ids, institution_id, document_ids, experiment_ids are deliberately not written (v0.2 A1 derived fields).
